tools.name: list_accelerators
tools.description: List recorded accelerator specifications, with units, field provenance and unknowns. At most 50 per page.

tools.name: get_accelerator
tools.description: Get one exact accelerator model or canonical slug. Unknown models are errors, not guessed specifications.

tools.name: compare_accelerators
tools.description: Compare 2–4 distinct exact models side by side; no invented performance score or compatibility ranking.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List GPU compute services with field-scoped official provenance, independent of priced offers and live stock.

tools.name: find_offers
tools.description: Find recorded offers with bounded price/count/VRAM filters. Unknown units, scope or counts never pass numeric filters. Billing is a case-insensitive substring; availability is recorded, not live.

tools.name: list_price_history
tools.description: Read actual approved GPU price observations, newest first. UTC dates filter capture time; distinct configurations are not one price trend.

tools.name: compute_capability
tools.description: Retrieve source-backed NVIDIA CUDA hardware compute capability context; non-CUDA is not assigned a CC. No toolkit/framework guarantee.

tools.name: estimate_qdrant
tools.description: Calculate deterministic Qdrant capacity using the site's shared real engine. KiB inputs, byte outputs; not measured capacity or QPS sizing.

tools.name: list_qdrant_pricing
tools.description: List dated official managed Cloud package quotes, not live prices or hardware recommendations.
